create_RASampler_for_distributed_trainin: create a RASampler instance for distributed training with repeated augmentations and configurable shuffle
use_RASampler_shuffler_generator: use the RASampler shuffler method to generate repeated shuffled indices for a dataset
iterate_RASampler_indices: iterate over a RASampler to get subsampled indices for the current rank in distributed training
set_RASampler_epoch: set the epoch on a RASampler instance to control shuffling behavior per training epoch
collate_batch_with_list_collate: collate a batch of variable-sized inputs into lists instead of stacked tensors using list_collate
